invalid_credentials.error_contains: Your email or password is incorrect

performance._comment_thresholds: All thresholds are tuned for automationexercise.com (free shared hosting). Expect response times of 1-3s under normal load, with occasional spikes to 4-5s during peak traffic. Thresholds are set at ~2x typical response times to avoid flaky failures while still catching genuine regressions. Adjust values down for faster/dedicated infrastructure.
performance._comment_api_response_time_ms: Global ceiling for API response time. Typical: 500-2000ms. Burst/peak observed: 3500-4700ms. Set to 5000ms to absorb network variability on shared hosting.
performance._comment_page_load_time_ms: Global ceiling for DOMContentLoaded. Typical: 2000-4000ms. Peak observed: 6300ms. Set to 8000ms to account for ad scripts, consent overlays, and CDN latency.
performance._comment_cls_threshold: Cumulative Layout Shift. Google 'good' threshold is 0.1, 'needs improvement' is 0.25. Set to 0.35 because the site loads dynamic ad banners that cause layout shifts beyond our control.
